changelog: - **Details opened from the keyboard on the phone puts focus in the sheet.** The read-only Inspector sheet opened with focus left on the page: nothing showed focus, the next Tab walked the run bar before it reached the sheet, and the keys could not scroll the sheet, so a long Inspector could not be read past its first screen. Every field in that sheet is disabled, and the dialog focus rule took the first one anyway. A dialog or sheet now gives focus to its first control that can take it, and with no usable field that is its Close. The Monte Carlo dialog opened again while its run goes, whose fields are disabled then, does the same.
